name: sent_creeps_come_stronger
description: A sent creep is stronger than the wave's own (the owner's decision of 2 November 2026, as a mercenary is; the duel's send_hp_pm, contract-m7 §2): seat 1 uncorks the Gourd Rush in wave 2, and each of its Gourdlings on seat 2's road has its pack's premium (the duel's pack_hp_pm for the swarm pack, send_hp_pm where a pack has none of its own, the packs' matrix) per mille of the health wave 2's own Gourdlings have there, which is a Gourdling's at wave 2's growth. The pack is the tier's count from PACKS.

steps.msg: wave 2's own Gourdling: 24 health, a quarter grown
the sent one has the premium on top
the pack is the tier's count
